title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Settlement Deduction: Service Call Fee and Timing
content:
The settlement deduction on a cash settlement under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons follows the request's fee and the timing of the customer's decision:

| The request being settled carries its service call fee entry | Settlement taken, counted in calendar days after the covered determination | Settlement deduction |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No more than 3 days | Zero |
| Yes | More than 3 days | USD 25.00 |
| No | Any | USD 50.00 |

The service call fee entry is the one on the rider's billing ledger linked to the request being settled; the days are counted from the date of the request's covered coverage determination, that date being day zero.

## Boundary days (hypothetical, request carrying its service call fee entry)

| Day of the settlement after the covered determination | Settlement deduction |
|---|---|
| Day 3 | Zero |
| Day 4 | USD 25.00 |

**Hypothetical case.** A request with no service call fee entry on the ledger, settled the day after its covered determination: USD 50.00.
